# cursorkit

> Mouse cursors as SVG with the hotspot (the pixel that clicks) as data. For drawn cursors in demos, mockups, screenshots and videos, agent pointers, and custom CSS cursors. Original drawings, MIT, zero dependencies.

Do not hand-draw cursor SVG paths, and do not use icon-set "mouse-pointer" icons as cursors. In an ordinary app UI, prefer the CSS keyword (cursor: pointer).

## Cursors

arrow (default), pointer, grab, grabbing, text, crosshair, not-allowed, move, ew-resize, ns-resize, nwse-resize, nesw-resize

## Use

- npm: `import { cursor } from "@pallaoro/cursorkit"`; `cursor(name, { theme?: "light" | "dark", size?: number, shadow?: boolean, ink?: string, paper?: string })` returns `{ svg, dataUri, width, height, hotspot: { x, y }, css }`. `css` is a full value for the CSS cursor property.
- CLI: `npx @pallaoro/cursorkit <name> [--css | --json] [--theme dark] [--size n] [--no-shadow]`; `npx @pallaoro/cursorkit list`. Without flags it prints the SVG and writes the hotspot to stderr.
- CDN: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@pallaoro/cursorkit@0.1/svg/{light|dark}/{name}.svg`, hotspots in `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@pallaoro/cursorkit@0.1/cursors.json`.

## Placing

To point at (x, y), put the image's top-left at (x - hotspot.x, y - hotspot.y). Hotspots are whole pixels at every size; ask for a size rather than scaling the image.

## Docs

- [Agent skill](https://github.com/pallaoro/cursorkit/blob/main/skills/cursorkit/SKILL.md): `npx skills add pallaoro/cursorkit`
